Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.161 of 2024, under Section 498A, 304B, 302,
201 Ipc & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Nawabganj, District Gonda.
3.  Learned counsel for the applicant argues that mother-in-law was granted bail vide order dated 26.07.2024.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: 5. Considering and adopting the reasoning as contained in the order dated 26.07.2024, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. Let the applicant Safat Mohd. be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
